none: PAS LON-92ED53: Roman ceramic base from a Samian vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

This is a Roman ceramic base from a Samian vessel, probably a dish or a bowl Dragendorff form 18/31, dating AD90-150. The vessel has a foot ring and on the internal surface the base rises to a peak. There is a maker's mark stamped across the internal surface of the base within an incised linear ring which in turn is enclosed within a stamped ring. The ring comprises a repeated crescent-shaped…
